desc:
Drink an entire lake dry — then do it again on a whole new island. 🌊
Collect pets, unlock legendary straws, and race your friends to the bottom!

🥤 SIP — fill your belly to bursting
🧊 POUR — empty it into the ice machine and cash in
🐾 PETS — hatch eggs and collect pets that boost every single sip
🏝️ ISLANDS — unlock new lakes, each hiding its own secrets
⚡ UPGRADE — buy a better straw and drink way faster
🔑 COLLECT — 10 legendary straws, hidden chests, golden keys
🐊 SURVIVE — a hungry crocodile is waiting in the deep water...

Every gulp drops the water level lower... and the lower it gets, the more it
reveals. Golden KEYS are buried at the very bottom — but you'll have to drink
your way down to reach them.

The lake won't drink itself. 🌊

🎁 Spin the wheel every day for free rewards
👍 LIKE + FAVORITE to get notified when new islands drop
